artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gouache and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a series of curved, intertwined lines forming an abstract pattern on a brownish textured background. The lines twist around each other to create circular shapes that contain designs resembling four-petal flowers.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gouache and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image displays an arrangement of wavy lines and elongated leaf-like shapes intersecting with the lines, all within an abstract composition. The central wavy line and leafy shapes resemble a flowing vine adorned with leaves. This abstract design is set against a band of earthy brown tones, bordered by parallel horizontal lines above and below. The use of muted colors and the organic flow of the elements create a harmonious visual resembling stylized nature.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gouache, pen and black ink, and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative border design. The image shows a horizontal arrangement of foliage, red berries, and a pink ribbon against a golden background. The leaves are elongated, rendered in different shades of green, and mixed with clusters of bright red berries. A pink ribbon weaves through the greenery, with loops and knots. On the right, a blue rectangle is bordered by curved and wave-like elements in golden hues. The composition is framed by outlines indicating depth and structure.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gouache, graphite, and conté crayon on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows an arrangement of elongated, curved lines forming a pattern of repeated vertical ovals, bordered by horizontal lines on the top and bottom. The colors used are beige and brown, giving an impression of an ancient or natural material like wood or stone.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gouache, graphite, and conté crayon on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image displays a design featuring large pink leaves in two horizontal rows, each decorated with small red circles. The color scheme includes pink, red, orange, white, and brown tones. The design is centered in a rectangular section with orange and white stripes, set against a tan background. The objects are symmetrically arranged within the available space.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gouache, graphite, and conté crayon on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows an arc-shaped design with white flowers and green leaves on a dark background. Surrounding the arc is a mix of ochre and beige tones. The color palette includes ochre, beige, green, grey, and soft white. Two circular elements with floral patterns are present at each end of the arc; one circle has a red background, and the other has a yellow background. The central part of the arc comprises flowers and leaves, encircled by a curved border.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gouache and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image depicts intersecting lines and shapes. A central horizontal green line extends across the image with oblong shapes resembling leaves and small circular red forms. Blue rectangular patches and orange wavy brushstrokes border the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gouache and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image showcases curved lines and shapes on a textured background. A pink ribbon weaves between green leaf-like forms and red round shapes. The layout suggests a decorative border or natural design, with organic shapes intertwining to create a continuous pattern. Earthy tones and vibrant accents contrast, enhancing the texture of the piece.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: gouache and graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and looping curves against a rectangular background, creating an abstract pattern. The lines resemble tendrils or vines that intertwine with leafy shapes and floral elements. The pattern includes shades of brown, green, and red.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design [recto]
artworks.medium: watercolor, graphite, and gold paint on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image features elongated, pointed shapes that converge at a central axis, forming an abstract arrangement. Interspersed among these shapes are small circular forms. The composition is framed on the right by a vertical, wavy border pattern. The background color is earthy.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows two rough semi-circular outlines with abstract sketches of human figures. In the upper section, two figures are depicted: one standing and holding a large bowl-like shape, while the other is bending down. The lower section features another set of figures: one handling a wavy object and the other holding a circular shape.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: oil with gold and copper paint on canvas
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image depicts a rectangular decorative piece with a central pattern of stylized leaves and berries, flanked by wavy, ribbon-like borders. The color palette includes muted greens, soft pinks, earthy browns, and a subtle gold background with a cream border. The central design is vertically aligned in the middle of the piece, while the borders run parallel on either side. The decorative piece is placed centrally within a larger beige frame.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a series of curved lines forming arch-like shapes resembling small hills or mounds. These shapes are arranged in an abstract pattern on the paper. Pairs of pointed shapes extend upwards from the top of each curved structure, while clustered oval shapes hang down below, suggesting a string of grapes or berries. The abstract drawing evokes a landscape with stylized plants.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a symmetrical pencil sketch with four large leaf-like shapes arranged diagonally across a central horizontal line, with clusters of small circles in between them. The color palette is monochromatic, comprising shades of gray from the pencil on a light beige paper. The leaf-like shapes and circular forms are crisscrossed with several curving and looping lines, and there are three parallel lines running horizontally in the background.

artworks.title: Studies for Border Designs
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows three wavy lines running horizontally across the page, bordered by abstract leaf-like shapes and clusters resembling berries. The design resembles a decorative vine or stylized floral border, often seen in patterns on textiles or wallpapers. The shapes create a rhythmic effect, connecting like a continuous garland.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite on trimmed book page of tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows swirling, looping lines forming an abstract pattern on the paper. The shapes resemble intricate tendrils or vine-like forms, intertwining and overlapping. Below the abstract design are printed numbers and fractions, giving the appearance of a vintage ticket or perforated card. The composition combines freeform abstract lines with structured numerical elements, creating a juxtaposition of organic and geometric elements.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite on trimmed book page of tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image features a series of curved and arched lines intersecting and overlapping across the canvas, creating an abstract composition. The central shapes resemble elongated leaves or flattened oval forms, which are intersected by tight, swirling lines. Clusters of small, round shapes appear sporadically. These elements are mirrored on either side of a faint horizontal line that runs through the center of the image. The overall composition evokes complexity and intricacy often found in nature, juxtaposed with the simplicity of abstract art.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and conté crayon on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This drawing shows an ornamental pattern. It comprises alternating light and dark rectangular panels. The light rectangles contain stylized flowers with radiating petals, while the dark panels feature abstract leaf-like forms. The design is framed by simple geometric shapes on top and a subtle wave pattern at the bottom. The left side shows detailed shading and contrast, while the right side is more faint. The pattern balances geometric and organic elements.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative band featuring symmetrical floral and leaf motifs. The design consists of a repeating pattern of stylized flowers with elongated petals and small circular elements between them. The flowers are aligned horizontally, filling a rectangular strip bordered by faint pencil lines. At one end, the design tapers into a more ornate flourish. The drawing appears to be a sketch or study for a decorative element. The use of pencil on paper gives it a light and unfinished appearance, focusing on the form and layout of the pattern.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: black conté crayon on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows a curved strip with abstract shapes and patterns drawn along it. There are circular forms with radial lines on the left and right ends, resembling sunbursts or star-like designs. In the center, there are two square shapes with spiraling lines inside. Between these elements are elongated leaf-like forms and wavy lines. The composition is sketched on a light brown background.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: black conté crayon on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image displays an abstract arrangement of lines and oval shapes. On the left side, there is a circular form with wavy and branching lines inside. Extending to the right, there is a sequence of oval shapes arranged along a central line, bordered by two parallel curved lines.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image shows swirling, looping lines interspersed with elongated oval shapes in an abstract style. The composition may suggest flowing calligraphy or decorative ironwork. The larger loops could resemble musical notes, while the smaller curves give the sense of ribbons or waves undulating. The design captures the delicate traces of a dancer's movements.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design
artworks.medium: graphite on yellow tracing paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative floral pattern. The drawing is on a piece of irregularly cut brown paper, featuring an intricate design of swirling lines and stylized floral motifs. The pattern consists of cloud-like shapes with rounded edges and scalloped contours. The lines are delicately rendered, creating a sense of flow and movement across the composition. The style suggests a study or blueprint for a decorative motif or pattern, perhaps intended for a textile or architectural embellishment.

artworks.title: Study for a Border Design with a Sketch of a Tree
artworks.medium: purple pencil and graphite on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Mark Borghi
artworks.description: The image depicts pencil sketches of botanical elements, such as coniferous branches on the upper left and stylized floral patterns on the right. The color palette consists of soft graphite grays on a warm beige paper background. The conifer-like branches are sprawled naturally towards the top left, while the floral patterns are organized vertically on the right side.
